title: Cognitive task identification from fMRI maps
scientific_question: Can a complete sanitized fMRI statistical map predict its declared acquisition protocol for a held-out person, beyond spatial support and construction metadata?
primary_outputs: The source-adjudicated25-protocol catalogue label for each map, not a uniquely identified mental process.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Sanitized unthresholded statistical maps retaining native geometry, all voxels and spatial units; header-free little-endian float64 conversion retains scaling.
Explicitly separated neural-value and nuisance/support views; permitted training labels from other people only.
forbidden_inputs: Task/contrast names, answer-bearing filenames/headers, private catalogue labels and target-coded masks.
Held-person training labels and unrestricted labelled public source lookup during the case.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Complete catalogue source requires9532 unique case IDs across13 people,25 protocols and300 available person/protocol cells; source identities and labels are trusted joins, not candidate names.
allowed_inputs.split: Whole-person outer holdout; AP/PA/FFX and contrast dependencies stay within the person. Training-select reference family without outer labels; equal three candidate repetitions are paired rather than selecting the best.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Complete current source:9532 maps (3505AP,3975PA,2052FFX),13 people,25 protocols,300 cells,234 access/condition/repetition contexts. sub-02 has12 protocol cells, sub-08 has13, the other11 have25. The earlier312-map panel remains separately scoped historical evidence.

biological_unit: Thirteen biological people; AP/PA/FFX maps, contrasts and repetitions remain nested.
case_definition: One complete native-grid statistical map, nested in person/protocol/construction.

split.policy: Whole-person outer holdout; AP/PA/FFX and contrast dependencies stay within the person. Training-select reference family without outer labels; equal three candidate repetitions are paired rather than selecting the best.
split.coverage: Complete current source:9532 maps (3505AP,3975PA,2052FFX),13 people,25 protocols,300 cells,234 access/condition/repetition contexts. sub-02 has12 protocol cells, sub-08 has13, the other11 have25. The earlier312-map panel remains separately scoped historical evidence.

reference.role: Pinned author map/dictionary and classification analyses. The inspected decoder splitter is not participant-disjoint, and dictionary analysis is not yet an unseen-task predictor.

controls: Keep full geometries/support and construction labels in trusted scoring; compare nuisance-enriched views rather than assuming sanitization removes every fingerprint.
Do not pool AP/PA and fixed-effect derivatives as independent people.
Resolve contemporary official raw-data route ds002685 and map collection6618 against the exact frozen catalogue; original ds000244 registration route alone is insufficient.

direct_observation.representation: A sanitized map plus fixed label ontology could support a bounded no-tools observation condition.
direct_observation.boundary: Require a frozen representation preserving equivalent visible support and no metadata shortcuts.
missing: No current no-tools case transport or complete response collection

typed_viewer.representation: Typed slice/overlay queries could expose map values without raw files.
typed_viewer.boundary: No source filenames/header labels/raw-array returns; rendering may change information relative to programme views.
missing: Typed viewer, matched view budget and transport qualification

tool_assisted.representation: I arm can investigate full permitted neural/nuisance views with numerical/model tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: Complete held-person support, matched resources and no hidden target/reference feedback.

frozen_program.representation: F arm snapshot precedes query access; same full catalogue and views.
frozen_program.boundary: Single precommitted programme per context with actual source/runtime/custody receipts.

primary.name: Person-macro available-protocol balanced accuracy
primary.aggregation: Each person gets equal weight; each available protocol within person equal weight; maps within person/protocol equal weight. Average all three frozen repetitions, never best repetition.
primary.rationale: Grades known source labels while preventing prolific contrasts/protocols or repeated attempts from dominating.

secondary: Brier score with explicit2.0 failure penalty, weighted and unweighted coverage, per-person/protocol/construction failure counts.
I-minus-F paired per-person effects and comparisons against training-selected references.

comparators.name: Uniform and weighted training prior
comparators.procedure: Implemented25-class priors; training-weighted prior uses the same hierarchy.

comparators.name: Training-selected source reference bank
comparators.inputs: Neural, nuisance, and combined views on identical permitted support
comparators.procedure: Complete source joins455 selected references and91 training-selected aliases; select only from training support.

comparators.name: Spatial-scrambled and C-only controls
comparators.inputs: Same map/support metadata under declared scrambling or nuisance-only view
comparators.procedure: Implemented companion conditions; support fingerprints can remain and must be disclosed.

nuisance_controls: Keep full geometries/support and construction labels in trusted scoring; compare nuisance-enriched views rather than assuming sanitization removes every fingerprint.
Do not pool AP/PA and fixed-effect derivatives as independent people.
Resolve contemporary official raw-data route ds002685 and map collection6618 against the exact frozen catalogue; original ds000244 registration route alone is insufficient.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented10000 fixed-seed person bootstrap and leave-one-person-out contrasts use13 people after averaging three repetitions; interpretation is conditional descriptive catalogue support, not independent repeated-trial population inference.
evaluation.failure_policy: Unknown IDs are evaluator errors; absent/None predictions retain their fixed denominator with accuracy0 and Brier penalty2.0. Complete9532/13/25/300 scope and all required conditions/repetitions are mandatory.
